title: [FR] - Option to control storr's `use_cache`
description:
The storr interface has an optional in memory cache layer that is enabled by default e.g. `obj$set(key, val, use_cache = TRUE)`  and there is no global option to control it.

On some occasions, we might not need the build-in cache mechanism because we're using Redis driver via redux (and might cause issues for concurrent writes)  or simple do not want to cache.

Will it be possible to have a global option as toggle for  cache mechanism?

title: [question] on `$clean_stale()`
description:
The following for loop calls storr's `$clear` method, which applies to namespaces, but here the loop uses the keys to be deleted (no effect).
https://github.com/thomasp85/firesale/blob/e4e39c2949fa852c278a555afa13b299c0abf87f/R/FireSale.R#L170-L172


Nevertheless, aged keys are deleted straight after:
https://github.com/thomasp85/firesale/blob/e4e39c2949fa852c278a555afa13b299c0abf87f/R/FireSale.R#L173-L174

Was the for loop reserved or intended for something else? (or misunderstood it..?)
